implementation_notes: Rust enforces it: struct fields are private by default and module `pub` controls the surface. `pub(crate)` scopes visibility, traits are the published promise, and owned return types (`String`, `Vec<T>`) hand over nothing shared.
idiom_name: private fields by default + pub(crate) scoping + owned returns
pitfalls: `pub` on every field for convenience, which exposes the layout as API
Returning `&[T]` into internal storage whose lifetime outlives the contract
